Info

Parameter bundle holding external dependencies for ScarajectoryGUI assembly.

class scarajectory.infrastructure.gui.scarajectory_gui_init_bundle.ScarajectoryGUIInitBundle(*, plan: PlanPipelineBundle, validator: ITrajectoryValidator, streaming: StreamingBundle, storage: IPlanStorageService, dsl_service: IScaraDslService, connection_repository: IConnectionRepository)[source]¶

Bundle containing external collaborators for GUI assembly.
